The product (target) after retrosynthesis would be a precursor with a halide (e.g., C-Cl) and a nucleophile (e.g., OH, NH2). The template should involve breaking halide and forming amine (since we have amide? Actually the target has an amide linking to heterocycle. The SN2 could be formation of C-N bond (amine) displacing halide. So we need a template that breaks halide and forms amine. In search we used functional_groups_broken halide, formed primary amines.
